⭐ Honest Review – Be Cautious and Demand Transparency

I recently visited this service center and while the staff spoke respectfully, I had a concerning experience that I want to share so others can be careful.

When I submitted my laptop, they charged ₹1475 upfront for a "non-refundable diagnostic test." Two days later, they call me and claimed there was a power issue with the CPU, saying it might require major repairs with only a 50-50 chance of success. They warned the motherboard might be permanently damaged during repair. I agreed reluctantly, but requested to see the diagnostic report I had paid for.

To my surprise, they refused to provide any report, saying it was “practically impossible.” I asked for a multimeter reading or voltage test video—again, they denied, instead giving me a lecture on “trust.”

But trust is earned, not blind. If customers are expected to pay before diagnosis and not receive any report, where’s the fairness in that? If they really value trust, they should first trust customers too—diagnose first, then ask for payment.

Here’s the shocking part: it was just a BIOS and Windows update issue—no hardware problem at all. I solved it myself at home without opening the laptop. Had I trusted them blindly, they might have "repaired" it and claimed a motherboard replacement worth ₹30,000!

Thankfully, after confronting them, they refunded the full amount. That itself speaks volumes.

⚠️ My Advice to Others:

Always ask for a full diagnostic report and video proof of the issue.

Don't accept vague answers like “trust us” when your hard-earned money and laptop’s life are at stake.

Ensure the workspace is professional, clean, and ESD-safe—we have no idea what happens behind closed doors.

They were polite, but transparency and honesty matter more than just soft-spoken words. Don’t get fooled—stay informed and alert.
